_method: Every number in this report is measured directly from repository data files at generation time, except the 'popular'/alternate values in countingRuleSensitivity, which are quoted verbatim from numbers.html's own prose (already-published editorial text, not independently measurable from a data file) and are marked verified:false accordingly. Source registry fields are read verbatim from data/sources.json; any field absent there is recorded as "not stated in repository", never inferred.

morphology._method: Every token in data/morphology/{1..114}.json scanned directly; a field counts as present if its value is a non-empty string. The morphology 'gloss' field exists on every token but is empty on all of them (0% populated) and is not a coverage field this script reports separately, since it is never populated.

rootGloss.reason: no verified gloss source present in repository
rootGloss._note: assets/root-meanings.js provides 84 short editorial glosses (out of 1642 roots). Its own file header states these are editorial working glosses, not quotations from a citable dictionary, and instructs that they not be presented as Verified. Not counted toward the coverage figure above. data/gloss/{surah}.json provides per-word (not per-root) glosses transcribed from Khan (2011), covering 6 of 114 surahs; it cannot answer per-root coverage.

qursim._method: Counted data/qursim/{surah}.json files present for surah numbers 1-114.
